requirements_html:
Recommended teams:

  • LR Meli, SheMeli, SheBan, R King
  • Odin, Gawain, G Tyr, G Hel

License key needed. Paste your key here the first time you use a private Farmer. Don't have a key yet? Ask us for a free one. Once it works, we'll remember it securely on this Windows account, so you won't need to enter it again.

You'll need an internet connection whenever you start a private Farmer. Each key can only be used on the first computer it activates.

Set your Surtr team before starting. The Farmer supports teams with or without Odin and stops after your chosen number of clears.
